source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the male reproductive system (PDF 73-77).

blocks.text: Mardana reproductive system ke hisse aur un ke kaam neeche bayan kiye gaye hain.
1- Gonads (testes)

Do testes pait (abdomen) ke bahar jild ki ek theli mein hote hain jise scrotum kehte hain. Har testis anda-numa (oval) hai, taqreeban 3–5 cm lamba aur 2–3 cm chaura. Testis bohat zyada bal khayi hui (highly convoluted) seminiferous tubules se bana hai. In tubules ki deewar, yani germinal epithelium, mein do qism ke cells hote hain: germline cells aur Sertoli cells. Germline cells meiosis se sperms (spermatozoa) banate hain, aur Sertoli cells banne wale sperms ko ghiza dete hain.

blocks.alt: (a) Mardana pelvis baghal se: peshab ka bladder, us ke peeche rectum aur aage pubic bone; bladder ke neeche prostate gland; bladder ke peeche seminal vesicle; scrotum ke testis aur epididymis se vas deferens oopar ja kar bladder ke oopar se guzarti aur seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar prostate mein ejaculatory duct banti hai; prostate ke neeche bulbourethral gland; penis mein se guzarti urethra. (b) Khula hua testis: lobules mein seminiferous tubules, rete testis, epididymis aur vas deferens.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.1: (a) Mardana tolidi nizam; (b) Testis ki tarash (kitab ki Figure 17.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sperm ka rasta khaake mein dhoondein: seminiferous tubules (b) se rete testis, phir epididymis, phir vas deferens jo oopar ja kar bladder ke oopar se ghoomti hai, phir seminal vesicle ki nali se mil kar ejaculatory duct, jo prostate ke andar urethra mein khulti hai, aur urethra penis se bahar. Kitab ki tasveer mein label 'Urethera' chhapa hai; sahih hijje (spelling) 'Urethra' hai, jo hamare khaake mein likha hai.
2- Accessory ducts (madadgar nalyan)

Seminiferous tubules se spermatozoa nalyon ke ek jaal (network) mein jate hain jise rete testis kehte hain. Yahan se woh ek lambi, bal khayi nali, epididymis, mein dakhil hote hain. Yahan tak spermatozoa harkat nahin kar sakte (non-motile). Woh kam az kam 18 ghante epididymis mein rehte hain, phir harkat ke qabil (motile) ho kar ek aur lambi nali, vas deferens, mein jate hain. Vas deferens inguinal canal ke raaste pait ke andar (abdominal cavity mein) jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein ek jagah “vas deference” chhapa hai; sahi naam vas deferens hai (sperm le jane wali nali), jaisa pichle jumle mein likha hai.

blocks.title: For Information: testes bahar kyun hain
blocks.text: Nashonuma ke dauran testes pait ke andar bante hain. Paidaish se thora pehle woh ek surakh se neeche utar kar scrotum mein aa jate hain. Scrotum testes ko taqreeban 34°C par rakhta hai, jo jism ke andaruni temperature (37°C) se thora kam hai. Sperms ki nashonuma ke liye yahi kam temperature zaroori hai.

Har testis ki vas deferens ek seminal vesicle (ek gland) ki nali se mil jati hai. Milne ke baad is nali ko ejaculatory duct kehte hain. Dono testes se aane wali do ejaculatory ducts prostate gland ke andar se guzarti hain aur wahan urethra mein khulti hain; urethra urinary bladder (peshab ki thaili) se aati hai. Urethra penis ke zariye jism se bahar khulti hai.
3- Accessory glands (madadgar glands)
Yeh woh glands hain jo sperms mein fluids (mayi) mila kar semen banate hain:

items: Do seminal vesicles hain. Har gland ek nali ke zariye vas deferens mein fructose (sugar) se bhara fluid dalta hai. Yeh fluid sperm ko tawanai (energy) deta hai.

Prostate gland urinary bladder ke bilkul neeche hota hai. Yeh naram aur spongy hai aur semen ka taqreeban 60% fluid banata hai. Semen sperms aur seminal vesicles aur prostate gland ke fluids ka mixture hai.

Do chhote bulbourethral glands hain. Yeh saaf fluid chhorte hain jo sperm ke guzarne ke liye urethra ko chikna (lubricate) karta hai aur sperms ko zinda rehne ke liye hifazati neutral (na tezabi na alkaline) mahol deta hai.

blocks.text: 4- Copulatory organ (penis)
Mardana copulatory organ (jinsi milap ka uzv) penis kehlata hai. Is mein urethra, erectile tissue, ek artery aur do veins hoti hain.
Spermatogenesis (sperm ka banna)
Spermatogenesis woh amal hai jis se testes ki seminiferous tubules ke andar sperm bante hain.

Seminiferous tubules ki deewaron mein germline cells (2n) naam ke khaas cells mitosis se taqseem hote hain. Kuch naye cells spermatogonia (2n) ban jate hain aur kuch aainda ke liye germline cells hi rehte hain. Spermatogonia taqseem hote reh kar primary spermatocytes (2n) banate hain, jo tubule ki andaruni khali jagah (lumen) ki taraf barhte hain. Har primary spermatocyte meiosis-I se do secondary spermatocytes (1n) banata hai. Yeh foran meiosis-II se guzar kar spermatids (1n) banate hain. Is tarah ek spermatogonium (2n) se chaar spermatids (1n) bante hain, aur har spermatid pak kar ek lamba sperm ban jata hai.

Sperm ke teen hisse hain: head (sar), midpiece aur tail (dum). Genetic material (jeeni madda) head mein hota hai. Head ka taqreeban do-tihai (two-thirds) hissa ek moti topi se dhaka hota hai jise acrosome kehte hain. Acrosome zyada tar Golgi body se banta hai; is mein aise enzymes hote hain jo baad mein sperm ko ovum fertilize karne mein madad dete hain. Midpiece mein mitochondria aur ek centriole hota hai. Tail microtubules (axial filament) se bani hai jo midpiece ke centriole se nikalte hain.

Seminiferous tubules ke lumen mein maujood pakke hue spermatozoa harkat nahin kar sakte. Woh Sertoli cells ke chhore hue fluid ki madad se epididymis mein pohanchte hain, aur epididymis mein harkat ki salahiyat (motility) hasil karte hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: testis, seminiferous tubule ki tarash aur bari ki hui deewar: deewar ke saath spermatogonia, phir primary spermatocytes, secondary spermatocytes, spermatids aur lumen mein dum wale sperms, aur lamba Sertoli cell. Beech: germline cell, mitosis, spermatogonium, primary spermatocyte, meiosis-I se do secondary spermatocytes, meiosis-II se chaar spermatids, chaar sperms. Neeche: bara sperm: sar (acrosome, nucleus), centriole, mitochondria wala midpiece, axial filament wali dum.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.2: Spermatogenesis aur sperm ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 17.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Diagram ke teen hisse hain. Baen: testis aur seminiferous tubule ki tarash; deewar ka ek hissa bara kar ke dikhaya gaya hai jis mein bahar (deewar ke saath) spermatogonia, phir primary spermatocytes, phir secondary spermatocytes aur spermatids, aur beech (lumen) mein dum wale sperms hain; lamba Sertoli cell in sab ko sahara aur ghiza deta hai. Daen: yahi silsila seedhi qatar mein: germline cell, mitosis, spermatogonium, primary spermatocyte, meiosis-I se 2 secondary spermatocytes, meiosis-II se 4 spermatids, 4 sperms. Neeche: sperm ki banawat: head (acrosome aur nucleus), midpiece (centriole aur mitochondria) aur axial filament wali tail.
Mardana reproductive system ka hormonal qaboo

Spermatogenesis hypothalamus aur pituitary gland ke hormones ke qaboo mein hai. Hypothalamus gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) chhorta hai, jo anterior pituitary se follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) aur luteinizing hormone (LH) chhurwata hai.
FSH seminiferous tubules mein spermatogenesis karwata hai. LH Leydig cells (jo seminiferous tubules ke darmiyan interstitial tissue mein hote hain) se testosterone chhurwata hai.

Testosterone germinal epithelium ki nashonuma karwata hai aur mardana secondary sexual characteristics (sanvi jinsi khasusiyat) qaim rakhta hai. Jab anterior pituitary FSH chhorta hai to FSH Sertoli cells se inhibin naam ka peptide hormone chhurwata hai, jo mazeed FSH ka chhootna rok deta hai. Isi tarah jab LH Leydig cells se testosterone chhurwata hai to testosterone khud LH aur GnRH ka chhootna rok deta hai (negative feedback).

blocks.alt: Flow chart. Hypothalamus GnRH chhorta hai jo anterior pituitary gland tak jata hai; woh LH aur FSH chhorta hai. Testes mein LH Leydig cells par asar karta jo testosterone banate hain, jis se germinal epithelium banta hai; FSH Sertoli cells par asar karta jis se spermatogenesis hota hai, aur Sertoli cells inhibin chhorte hain. Nuqtedar (dotted) inhibition lakeerein testosterone se hypothalamus aur LH ki shaakh tak, aur inhibin se FSH ki shaakh tak jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.3: Mardana tolidi nizam ka hormonal qaboo (kitab ki Figure 17.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flow chart ko oopar se neeche parhein: hypothalamus GnRH chhorta hai, anterior pituitary LH aur FSH chhorta hai. Testes mein LH Leydig cells par asar karta hai (testosterone, phir germinal epithelium ki nashonuma) aur FSH Sertoli cells par (spermatogenesis). Nuqtedar (dotted) lakeerein 'Inhibition' hain: testosterone wapas ja kar hypothalamus aur LH ko rokta hai, aur Sertoli cells ka inhibin FSH ko rokta hai. Yahi negative feedback hai.

blocks.prompt: Seminiferous tubule se jism ke bahar tak sperm kin hisson se guzarta hai? Tarteeb se batayein.
blocks.explanation: Seminiferous tubule, rete testis, epididymis, vas deferens, ejaculatory duct (prostate gland ke andar), urethra, aur phir penis ke zariye bahar.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Testes scrotum mein (taqreeban 34°C): seminiferous tubules ki deewar mein germline cells (sperm banate) aur Sertoli cells (ghiza dete).

Nalyan: rete testis, epididymis (18 ghante, phir motile), vas deferens, ejaculatory duct, urethra. Glands: seminal vesicles (fructose), prostate (taqreeban 60% fluid), bulbourethral (chikna aur neutral fluid).
Spermatogenesis: germline cell, spermatogonium (2n), primary spermatocyte (2n), meiosis-I se 2 secondary spermatocytes (1n), meiosis-II se 4 spermatids (1n), 4 sperms.
GnRH se FSH aur LH; FSH: spermatogenesis aur inhibin; LH: Leydig cells se testosterone; inhibin FSH ko aur testosterone LH aur GnRH ko rokte hain.
